about.title: About Me
about.body: I'm Amaro Júnior (JrValerio), a Full Stack developer passionate about building solutions that combine technology, purpose, and accessibility. Since 2012, I've cared for my mother, teaching me resilience, empathy, and discipline. I've built projects like EcoVoz, EducaCristão GPT, Control Finance, Post-it Share App, and Fullstack Toybox — each blending creativity, real impact, and collaboration. My career change came from over 10 years in Payroll, bringing my experience in processes, organization, and empathy to tech. In development, I found my purpose: building inclusive technology, turning ideas into code, and connecting people. I've participated in hackathons, dev marathons, and completed bootcamps at Kenzie, Rocketseat, and courses at Alura. I'm committed to continuous learning and adaptation — I love challenges, learning, and sharing knowledge.
